summary: The main ansible-test subcommands are sanity, integration and units. Add --help to any command for details.
questions: What kinds of tests can ansible-test run?
How do I see all ansible-test commands?
Which command runs lint checks with ansible-test?

answer_card.title: Common ansible-test commands
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ansible-test sanity` runs sanity tests (linters, static analysis).
- `ansible-test integration` runs integration tests.
- `ansible-test units` runs unit tests.

Run `ansible-test --help` for the full list, or `ansible-test <command> --help` for one command.
